test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Her __modest__ behaviour was appreciated by everyone in the assembly.
solution: The correct answer is '**conceited**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the underlined word '**modest**' is '**conceited**'. • **Modest**: not talking too much about your own abilities, good qualities, etc. [विनम्र, विनीत (अपनी क्षमताओं आदि का बखान न करने वाला)] • *Example: She got the best results in the exam but she was too **modest** to tell anyone.* • **Conceited**: excessively proud of oneself; vain. (अहंकारी, घमंडी) • *Example: He’s so **conceited**—he thinks he’s the best at everything!* **Correct Answer:__** *conceited.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **distant**: a long way away in space or time. (स्‍थान या समय की दृष्टि से काफ़ी दूर) • **unpresuming**: modest; unassuming. (निःसंदेह) • **obvious**: easily seen or understood; clear. (जो आसानी से दिखाई दे या समझ में आए; स्‍पष्‍ट) 3a:Tb42, The correct answer is '**resplendent**'.
